text.cs: Synagoga v Augsburgu byla postavena mezi lety 1914 a 1917 podle návrhu architektů Friedricha Landauera a Dr. Heinricha Lömpela v secesním stylu.
text.da: Augsburg Synagogue is a synagogue on Halderstraße in Augsburg, Bavaria, Germany. It serves as the religious centre of the Israelitische Kultusgemeinde Schwaben-Augsburg, the Jewish community of Augsburg and Bavarian Swabia.
